notes.title: Release ver. 1.0.5 balancing and QoL
notes.content:
[p][b]new[/b][/p][list][*][p] added the ability to sort by value in the Your Aquarium menu
[/p][/*][*][p] added the ability to drag and drop around the fish cards in Your Aquarium menu using right click
[/p][/*][*][p] added auto-equip of a newly bought item
[/p][/*][*][p] added a new Setting to set the main screen in multi-monitor setups
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]balances[/b][/p][list][*][p] reduced chance of A and S tier fish early on
[/p][/*][*][p] fishing time now is slightly slower (a new set of items is in the works that will affect this variable)
[/p][/*][*][p] mid and late game fish now can go more time without food
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]upcoming updates[/b][/p][list][*][p] new set of items
[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.4
notes.content:
[b]fixes[/b]

- fixed the description of in-game Clown Fiesta and Tunak Tunak Tuna achievements.
- fixed Steam's Missing Achievements
- fixed Dark Bramble achievement not progressing
- fixed Size Matters Upgrade lvl 13 costing 50k when it should be 500k

to report any bugs, feel free to visit the discord available in the steam page
stay tuned for more stuff soon <3

notes.title: Demo Update 0.3 - 0.4 - 0.5 (Achievements, Save System, and +)
notes.content:
[p]Over the last couple of weeks I've been uploading the demo and here's all that's new since the 0.2 patch notes:[/p][p][/p][p]demo ver. 0.3.0 save system [/p][p][b]new[/b] [/p][list][*][p]added a save button in the settings menu,[/p][/*][*][p]game auto saves every 2 minutes[/p][/*][/list][p]
demo ver. 0.4.0 achievements[/p][p][b]new[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Achievements tab in the Collection Menu,[/p][/*][*][p]Fish now react with hearts when fed,[/p][/*][*][p]Character customization button in the Main Menu,[/p][/*][/list][p] [b]balance[/b] [/p][list][*][p]The Crystal Clear Upgrade rewards with more Jar space than before,[/p][/*][/list][p] [b]known issues[/b] [/p][list][*][p]the Character customization doesn't save the character between different play sessions
[/p][/*][/list][p]demo ver. 0.5.0 QoL improvements[/p][p][b]new[/b][/p][list][*][p]added more feedback when feeding fish.[/p][/*][*][p]added button to change the game window (top of screen or bottom), and option to change the offset in settings[/p][/*][*][p]added pin button to the Your Aquarium fish cards so that you can favorite fish and avoid selling them by mistake[/p][/*][*][p]added (finally) the fish state of each fish (their food and coin production progress) to the save system [/p][/*][*][p]added a Credits tab in the Settings Menu[/p][/*][/list][p][b]fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]fixed fish over eating when multiple food pieces are nearby[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo Update 0.2 (Upgrades!)
notes.content: [p]I've uploaded some minor fixes throughout the weeks but they were very small to warrant a full patch note, but this new update does deserve a highlight hehe[/p][p][/p][p][b]new[/b][/p][list][*][p] added Upgrades to the game! Check them out in the Shop Menu[/p][/*][*][p] added the coins generated per minute to the Suizopedia and Your Aquarium fish.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]fixed bug where menus would stack on top of each others.[/p][/*][*][p] fixed visual error where the text inside buttons would clip.[/p][/*][*][p] disabled the purchase of items in the Items Tab until their properties are fixed.[/p][/*][*][p] fixed error where certain values would be shown rounded down, for example 7.5k would be shown as 7k. Now it is shown as 7.5k.[/p][/*][*][p] adjusted volume levels to be lower by default[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]known bugs[/b][/p][list][*][p] fish go out of bounds and never come back (it's not personal, they just be doing that, I'm working on fixing it)[/p][/*][*][p]when using two monitors with different resolution, game gets stuck in the middle of both.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]upcoming updates[/b][/p][list][*][p]steam and in-game achievements![/p][/*][*][p]save system[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]as always thank you <3<3<3 for all the feedback and feel free to join the [url="https://discord.gg/fbMqTUnJZw"]discord[/url] if you haven't yet![/p][p]ALSOO, the [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hdchrom/suizokukan-project"]kickstarter[/url] is ending this very week, so if you want unique perks make sure to check it out right now! 👇[/p][p][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hdchrom/suizokukan-project"]www.kickstarter.com/projects/hdchrom/suizokukan-project[/url][/p]
